zh: 為什麼參加 Garmin Run？
en: Why did you sign up for Garmin Run?

zh: 這麼多跑者一起參加的盛會，當然要來感受一下啦！
en: Garmin Run is one of the biggest moments for runners, so of course I am joining.

zh: Garmin Run 幾乎就是我每年的固定行程！
en: Garmin Run is a race I make sure to join every year.

zh: 目標賽事之一，11月底是突破 PB 的好時機
en: It is one of my target races, and late November is a great time to break my PB.

zh: 賽前一晚收拾裝備，盤點補給策略的你……
en: The night before the race, while packing your gear...

zh: 輕便上場，喝水、補給交給沿途補給站
en: The chip is so hard to attach, and I can't forget my bib.

zh: 把裝備們排好來張大合照上傳社群
en: Pack as I usually do for a run. Familiar gear feels the most natural.

zh: 確認競速裝備與補給策略萬無一失
en: Plan my pace, fueling, and hydration schedule in advance.

zh: 軟水杯／軟水壺本來就在我的裝備清單裡
en: Bring my own hydration gear to make tomorrow's course more sustainable.

zh: 站在起跑線前你會……
en: At the starting line, you...

zh: 檢查儀容表情管理不能忘
en: Say hello to the runners around me and get ready to enjoy the event together.

zh: 等等就照自己的節奏跑，舒服完賽最重要
en: Warm up at my own pace and run as I normally do.

zh: 檢查手錶、鞋帶、確認配速策略
en: Check my watch, laces, and pacing strategy before giving it my all.

zh: 好緊張喔，腦袋一片空白
en: I am so hungry! A marathon is just an all-you-can-eat buffet with long distances between tables.

zh: 跑到 7.5K，前方終於出現補給站
en: At 7.5K, you finally see a hydration station ahead. You...

zh: 終於可以停下來休息喝水了
en: Join everyone at the station and enjoy this part of the course experience.

zh: 真希望可以隨時喝水，不想被補給站限制
en: Hydrate when it feels right, take a comfortable break, and keep going.

zh: 看準空檔，精準進站！
en: Make a precise, quick hydration stop without disrupting my rhythm.

zh: 優雅地拿出自己的軟水杯／軟水壺裝水。
en: Gracefully stop and fill my own soft cup or soft flask.

zh: 剩下最後 2K 啦！你心想……
en: Only 2K to go! You think...

zh: 終於快到終點啦！拱門、獎牌、完賽禮品我來啦~
en: Enjoy this final stretch too. The atmosphere of this race is amazing.

zh: 嗚嗚要結束了，美好的賽事總是過得特別快
en: Finish at my own pace and complete a comfortable run today.

zh: 維持配速就能破PB啦，加油撐住！
en: Hold this pace and I can break my PB. Keep going!

zh: 好累啊！下次不跑了嗚嗚，誰愛跑誰跑。
en: I am so tired! I am never running again. Whoever likes running can do it.

zh: 賽道體驗派
en: The Course Experience Runner
description_zh: 你重視和跑友一起參與活動、感受賽道與享受當下。
description_en: You value joining the event with fellow runners, feeling the course, and enjoying the moment.
hydration_title_en: Simple, light, and in your control
hydration_description_zh: 跑步不用搞得太複雜，找到舒服又適合自己的補水方式就好。軟水杯等輕便方式很適合你的節奏。
hydration_description_en: Running does not need to be complicated. Find a comfortable hydration approach that suits you, such as a lightweight soft cup.
cta_zh: 一起享受更好的賽道體驗
cta_en: Enjoy a better course experience together
image_alt_zh: 賽道體驗派圖片預留位置

zh: 賽道體驗派 × 永續先鋒
en: Course Experience Runner × Sustainability Pioneer
description_zh: 你在享受賽道與社群的同時，也願意用自己的方式讓賽道更永續。
description_en: While enjoying the course and community, you are also willing to help make the course more sustainable.

zh: 自在生活派
en: The Easy Lifestyle Runner
description_zh: 跑步已經自然融入你的生活，你照自己的節奏跑，也照自己的方式補水。
description_en: Running naturally fits into your life. You run at your own pace and hydrate your own way.
hydration_title_zh: 自主、隨性、不被補給站綁住
hydration_title_en: Independent, flexible, and free from station limits
hydration_description_zh: 我想怎麼跑就怎麼跑，補水也可以照自己的節奏。軟水壺或水袋背心都能讓你更自在。
hydration_description_en: Run your way and hydrate at your own pace. A soft flask or hydration vest can give you more freedom.
cta_en: Keep moving at your own pace
image_alt_zh: 自在生活派圖片預留位置

zh: 自在生活派 × 永續先鋒
en: Easy Lifestyle Runner × Sustainability Pioneer
description_zh: 自在跑步也能做出永續選擇，讓日常習慣成為賽道上的好改變。
description_en: Your everyday running habits can include sustainable choices and create positive change on the course.

zh: 精準急速派
en: The Precision Speed Runner
description_zh: 你重視訓練、目標與效率，喜歡掌握配速並持續突破成績。
description_en: You value training, goals, and efficiency. You like to control your pace and keep improving.
hydration_title_zh: 依情境選擇高效率補水
hydration_description_zh: 依照訓練與比賽目的，選擇最不影響節奏的補水方式，不必硬綁定單一產品。
hydration_description_en: Choose the hydration approach that least interrupts your rhythm for each training or race goal. No single product has to define you.
image_alt_zh: 精準急速派圖片預留位置

zh: 精準急速派 × 永續先鋒
en: Precision Speed Runner × Sustainability Pioneer
description_zh: 你追求效率，也願意把永續納入自己的跑步策略，讓每一步都更有意義。
description_en: You pursue efficiency while making sustainability part of your running strategy, giving every step more meaning.
